Definition: a Macbannite or native of Macbena
BiblicalUsage: Machbanai was one of the Gadites who came to David at Ziklag, named once, in 1 Chronicles 12:13, where Jeremiah the tenth and Machbanai the eleventh are listed among the mighty men. He came to David at Ziklag with the rest of the Gadites, and his name is the eleventh on their roll.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the eleventh man on the list mattered as much as the first: David's army was built one faithful name at a time.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
